The MSI Modern 14 C7M-062IN is the best value of the three at ₹43,219 because it is the only one with 16GB RAM.

Laptop	Price	Processor	RAM
MSI Modern 14 C7M-062IN	₹43,219	Ryzen 5 7530U	16GB
Acer Aspire Lite AL15-41	₹42,990	Ryzen 5 5625U	8GB
MSI Modern 14 C7M-284IN	₹45,990	Ryzen 5 7530U	8GB

All three have a 512GB SSD and Windows 11. The Acer is ₹229 cheaper but has an older processor. The second MSI costs ₹2,771 more than the first and has half the RAM, so I'd skip it.

Prices are from Smartprix, last updated Sat 24 Oct 2026. Check the shop's own price before you buy.
